newsitem.title: USA: U.S. crop condition and progress highlights - USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. crop condition and progress highlights - USDA.

text.p: The U.S. Department of Agriculture on Monday rated 2 percent of the corn crop in very poor condition, 7 percent poor, 26 percent fair, 47 percent good and 18 percent excellent.
The department pegged 3 percent of the soybean crop in very poor condition, 9 percent poor, 31 percent fair, 46 percent good and 11 percent excellent.
The department said 9 pct of the corn crop was harvested, versus 7 percent last week, 15 percent a year ago and the 17 percent five-year average.
It said 56 percent of the corn crop was mature, compared to 37 percent last week, 82 percent last year and the 72 percent five-year average.
USDA said 56 percent of the soybean crop was dropping leaves compared to 33 percent last week, 72 percent a year ago and the 71 percent average.
USDA said 18 percent of the cotton crop was harvested versus 12 percent last week, 21 percent a year ago and the average of 17 percent.
It said 18 percent of the winter wheat crop had emerged, compared to 14 percent a year ago and 21 percent average.
